title: A real interface, clicked through on eased arcs
goal:
A device for a real interface being used (_corpus/keyframes-full-visual.md 2.1, 3.7). params: `screen` (a real screenshot path, drawn at its real geometry), `targets` ({id, x, y, w, h} in screenshot pixels).

Verbs: enter (the screen rises in), move (the cursor travels on an eased arc to the event's target, via cursorPath in kit/verbs.ts), press (a 4-frame press ring and the target highlights in mint), type (text appears in the target via typeOn, 25 to 40 characters a second), exit.

## Tests
- the cursor is on its target by move + 10 and pressed only during press
- the highlight is mint and only on the pressed target
- typed text is empty before its event and whole by its end
- tall and wide fixtures render
contract: Rules for every device (apps/renderer/src/engine/devices/CONTRACT.md): Device({object, events, box, tokens, aspect, frame}), a pure function of its props; state only from stateAt(events, object.obj, frame); animation only from progress() and drift() with MOTION timing, and the helpers in kit/verbs.ts once they exist; colours only from tokens (raw hex refused); type roles from HOUSE_FONTS; no Math.random, no f % N, no wall clock; author 1080x1920 and 1920x1080 slots separately. Register the device in devices/registry.ts (one line) and in config/ve/devices.json with exactly the verbs below, and update verbs.test.ts. Follow the builder method in _corpus/keyframes-full-visual.md section 8: the picture comes from object.params (an image path for the real thing, its labels), never a generic shape standing in for it. Verbs, exactly: enter, move, press, type, exit.
acceptance:
npx vitest run apps/renderer/src/engine/devices/cursor_path
npx vitest run apps/renderer/src/engine/devices/verbs.test.ts
python scripts/ve/check_route.py
